secret.name: GCP service account
secret.description: A GCP service account key; fields as in its JSON key file. Regular scopes only read (GET, HEAD); a write needs a one-time approval or a scope extension, and deny and approval rules still apply during one. Denied: what hands the agent a credential (keys, signed URLs, certificates, batch, $rpc). Approval: changing permissions, running code as a service account or sending its token out. Not ruled, as get and list return them too: Run and Functions env, Composer envVariables, Workflows sourceContents, Build step env, Scheduler and Tasks headers and bodies, Compute metadata, Batch container passwords; keep secrets in Secret Manager and reference them. No connection for iamcredentials or sts (they mint credentials); no hosts list *.googleapis.com. container, firebase, pubsub, kms, identitytoolkit, bigquery, aiplatform, artifactregistry, spanner and cloudasset have none: each reaches a credential or code (container clientKey, pubsub push oidcToken, kms :decrypt); rule them like these first.

connections.name: GCP IAM
connections.description: Identity and Access Management API (iam.googleapis.com), v1 to v3, as the service account. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints, creating or uploading service account keys, signBlob and signJwt. One-time approval: setIamPolicy, creating and changing custom roles, writes to deny policies and to workload identity pools (v1 and v1beta; reading either runs), and any request on principal access boundary policies, policy bindings, access policies, workforce pools and OAuth clients.

connections.name: GCP Compute Engine
connections.description: Compute Engine API (compute.googleapis.com), /compute/v1, as the service account. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval (the rules cover v1, beta and alpha): setIamPolicy, project and instance metadata (ssh-keys, startup-script), an instance's service account, reading an instance's serial port output (serialPort), creating, replacing or bulk-inserting instances, creating instance templates, a zone's instanceSettings, creating and patching managed instance groups and their per-instance configs (each can carry a startup-script), and addSignedUrlKey.

connections.name: GCP Cloud Storage
connections.description: Cloud Storage JSON API (storage.googleapis.com), /storage/v1, as the service account. Read-only regular scope; the upload, download and XML API paths on the same host are outside it, so an extension with the path / opens all of them. Reading an object's content with alt=media is a read like reading its metadata. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints, creating HMAC keys. One-time approval: bucket, object and managed folder IAM policies, ACLs and default object ACLs, and patching or replacing a bucket (its acl, iamConfiguration and the predefinedAcl parameter) or an object's metadata (its acl). Not ruled: creating, composing, copying and rewriting an object can also set its ACL, through acl in the body or the predefinedAcl and destinationPredefinedAcl parameters. These are the main ways to write an object, so an approval rule on them would make every upload under an extension wait for the Owner. Turn on uniform bucket-level access and public access prevention on each bucket: with them, object ACLs have no effect.

connections.name: GCP Resource Manager
connections.description: Cloud Resource Manager API (cloudresourcemanager.googleapis.com), v1 to v3, as the service account: projects, folders, organizations, tags. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: setIamPolicy on a project, folder, organization, tag key or tag value; setting and clearing a v1 organization policy (setOrgPolicy, clearOrgPolicy); moving a project or folder (it inherits another parent's IAM policy); creating and deleting tag bindings and patching tag binding collections (a tag can satisfy the condition of an IAM binding).

connections.name: GCP Secret Manager
connections.description: Secret Manager API (secretmanager.googleapis.com), /v1, as the service account. Read-only regular scope: secret and version metadata. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: accessing a version's value (:access), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP API Keys
connections.description: API Keys API (apikeys.googleapis.com), /v2, as the service account. Read-only regular scope: key metadata and restrictions. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints, creating a key and reading a key string (keyString). One-time approval: setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Cloud SQL Admin
connections.description: Cloud SQL Admin API (sqladmin.googleapis.com), /v1, as the service account. Read-only regular scope; /sql/v1beta4 is outside it, and every rule below covers it too. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints, client certificates whose private key comes back in the response (generateEphemeralCert, createEphemeral, creating sslCerts). One-time approval: creating, changing (a password) and deleting the users of an instance (listing them runs), resetting the SSL configuration (resetSslConfig), running SQL (executeSql), exporting an instance's data to a bucket (export), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP OS Login
connections.description: Cloud OS Login API (oslogin.googleapis.com), /v1, as the service account. Read-only regular scope: login profiles; /v1beta is outside it, and every rule below covers it too. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints, signing an SSH public key (signSshPublicKey; the response is a signed SSH certificate). One-time approval: adding or changing an SSH public key (importSshPublicKey, creating and patching sshPublicKeys), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Organization Policy
connections.description: Organization Policy API (orgpolicy.googleapis.com), /v2, as the service account. Read-only regular scope: constraints. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: creating, changing and deleting the policies of a project, folder or organization (reading them runs), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Cloud Functions
connections.description: Cloud Functions API (cloudfunctions.googleapis.com), v1 and v2, as the service account. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints, generateDownloadUrl (its response is a signed URL to the function's source). One-time approval: creating and patching a function (its body names the service account it runs as and its source), calling a v1 function (:call), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Cloud Run
connections.description: Cloud Run Admin API (run.googleapis.com), /v2, as the service account. Read-only regular scope; the v1 paths (/v1 and the Knative-style /apis/serving.knative.dev/v1 and /apis/run.googleapis.com/v1) are outside it. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval (the body names the service account and the image, or overrides what a job runs): creating, patching or replacing services, jobs, worker pools and instances in v2 and v1, running a job (:run), submitting a build (builds:submit), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Cloud Build
connections.description: Cloud Build API (cloudbuild.googleapis.com), /v1, as the service account. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: creating a build, creating, patching, running and firing the webhook of a trigger (the body names the service account and arbitrary build steps), approving a build that waits for approval (:approve), reading Bitbucket Server and GitHub Enterprise configurations (they hold an API key and a webhook key), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Cloud Scheduler
connections.description: Cloud Scheduler API (cloudscheduler.googleapis.com), /v1, as the service account. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: creating and patching a job (its body can call any URL with a service account's OIDC or OAuth token), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Cloud Tasks
connections.description: Cloud Tasks API (cloudtasks.googleapis.com), /v2, as the service account. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: creating a task one at a time or in a batch and buffering one (:buffer), creating and patching a queue (its httpTarget can add a service account's OAuth or OIDC token and override the URL of every task), and setIamPolicy. Each of these can send a service account's token to any URL.

connections.name: GCP Workflows
connections.description: Workflows API (workflows.googleapis.com), /v1, as the service account: workflow definitions. Executions are on the connection GCP Workflow Executions. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: creating and patching a workflow (its body names the service account and source that can call any Google API), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Workflow Executions
connections.description: Workflow Executions API (workflowexecutions.googleapis.com), /v1, as the service account: executions of deployed workflows. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: starting an execution, directly or as a Pub/Sub trigger would (triggerPubsubExecution; the workflow runs as its service account), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Dataflow
connections.description: Dataflow API (dataflow.googleapis.com), /v1b3, as the service account. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: creating a job, creating or launching a template, launching a flex template (the body names the service account and the pipeline), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Cloud Composer
connections.description: Cloud Composer API (composer.googleapis.com), /v1, as the service account. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: creating and patching an environment (its body names the nodes' service account), running an Airflow command in it (executeAirflowCommand), loading and saving a snapshot (loadSnapshot replaces its DAGs and configuration), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Batch
connections.description: Batch API (batch.googleapis.com), /v1, as the service account. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: creating a job (its body names the service account and the runnables), and setIamPolicy.

connections.name: GCP Deployment Manager
connections.description: Cloud Deployment Manager API (deploymentmanager.googleapis.com), /deploymentmanager/v2, as the service account. Read-only regular scope. Denied: batch and $rpc endpoints. One-time approval: creating, replacing and patching a deployment (its configuration can create any resource, IAM bindings and service account keys included, as the Google APIs service agent), and setIamPolicy.
